sloka: यो ऽसौ चक्रगदापाणिः पीतवासा जनार्दनः ।हरिर्नारायणः श्रीमान् शरणं तं प्रपद्यथ ।। ७.६.३० ॥
transliteration: yo 'sau cakragadāpāṇiḥ pītavāsā janārdanaḥ ।harirnārāyaṇaḥ śrīmān śaraṇaṁ taṁ prapadyatha ।। 7.6.30 ॥

translations.english: O gods, those sons of Sukesha are not to be killed by me in battle; however, I shall give you a counsel (or a plan) that will indeed lead to their destruction.
